library.empty.description: Roku library screen: heading of the empty-state message shown when a library has no items.

library.emptyBody.description: Roku library screen: supporting line under the empty-state heading when a library has no items.

library.emptyNamed.description: Roku library screen: empty-state heading naming the library that has no items. {name}: the library's name, such as Movies.

library.emptyNamedBody.description: Roku library screen: supporting line under the named empty-state heading, telling the user media must be added on the server.

library.noMatches.description: Roku library screen: empty-state heading shown when the active filters hide every title.

library.clearFilters.description: Roku library screen: button under the no-matches message that removes all active filters.

library.recommended.description: Roku library section label (tab) for the recommended titles view of a library; also used in the library section list.

library.browse.description: Roku library section label (tab) for browsing all titles in a library; also used in the library section list.

library.collections.description: Roku library section label (tab) for the library's collections; also used in the library section list.

library.list.movies.description: Roku header of the list of movie libraries, shown in the home screen's library picker panel.

library.list.series.description: Roku header of the list of series (TV show) libraries, shown in the home screen's library picker panel.

library.list.hint.description: Roku remote-control hint at the bottom of the library picker. OK, the right arrow and Back refer to remote buttons; short, TV screen is cramped.

library.list.hintSingle.description: Roku remote-control hint shown in the library picker when a library has one section. OK and Back refer to remote buttons.

library.sortPill.description: Roku library screen: label on the sort pill button, showing the current sort. {name}: the active sort field, such as Title or Date Added.

library.sortSpoken.description: Roku screen reader announcement for the sort pill. {name}: the sort field, such as Title; {direction}: the order, such as A-Z or Newest.

library.sortBy.description: Roku library screen: header of the sort menu listing sort fields.

library.direction.az.description: Roku sort order label for alphabetical ascending, shown next to a sort field in the library sort menu and spoken by the screen reader.

library.direction.za.description: Roku sort order label for alphabetical descending, shown next to a sort field in the library sort menu and spoken by the screen reader.

library.direction.newest.description: Roku sort order label for newest first (date-based sorts), shown in the library sort menu and spoken by the screen reader.

library.direction.oldest.description: Roku sort order label for oldest first (date-based sorts), shown in the library sort menu and spoken by the screen reader.

library.direction.highest.description: Roku sort order label for highest value first (such as ratings), shown in the library sort menu and spoken by the screen reader.

library.direction.lowest.description: Roku sort order label for lowest value first (such as ratings), shown in the library sort menu and spoken by the screen reader.

library.direction.longest.description: Roku sort order label for longest first (runtime sorts), shown in the library sort menu and spoken by the screen reader.

library.direction.shortest.description: Roku sort order label for shortest first (runtime sorts), shown in the library sort menu and spoken by the screen reader.

library.filterPill.description: Roku library screen: label on the pill button that opens the filter panel.

library.filterSpoken.description: Roku screen reader announcement for the filter pill when filters are applied. {count}: the number of active filters.

library.shufflePill.description: Roku library and collection screens: label on the pill button that plays the titles in random order.

collections.empty.description: Roku library Collections view: empty-state heading when the library has no collections.

collections.emptyBody.description: Roku library Collections view: supporting line under the empty heading, saying collections are created on the server.

collections.emptyItems.description: Roku collection screen: empty-state message when the opened collection contains no items.

collections.item.description: Roku collection screen: item count label in uppercase above the grid. Counts the items in the collection. {count}: the number of items.

collections.audio.description: Roku screen reader announcement for a collection card. {name}: the collection's name; {count}: the item count text, such as 12 items.

collections.back.description: Roku collection screen: action button on the empty or error state that returns to the list of collections.

boxSets.label.description: Roku tag in uppercase on a box set's card and detail page identifying it as a box set (a group of related movies).

boxSets.searchHeading.description: Roku search results: section heading above the box sets (groups of related movies) that match the search.

boxSets.movies.description: Roku box set screen: section heading above the grid of movies that belong to the box set.

boxSets.film.description: Roku box set card and detail page: number of films in the box set. Counts the movies in it. {count}: the number of films.

boxSets.watchedCard.description: Roku box set card: watched progress caption. Counts the movies in the box set. {played}: how many have been watched; {count}: the total number of movies.

boxSets.watchedFact.description: Roku box set detail page: watched progress fact in the metadata line. {played}: how many movies have been watched; {count}: the total number of movies in the box set.

boxSets.play.description: Roku box set detail page: label of the play button for a box set not yet started. {title}: the title of the movie that will play.

boxSets.continue.description: Roku box set detail page: label of the play button that resumes a started box set. {title}: the title of the movie to continue.

boxSets.audio.description: Roku screen reader announcement for a box set card. {title}: the box set's name; {films}: the film count text, such as 3 films.

boxSets.thisFilm.description: Roku movie detail page: uppercase flag on the card, among the box set's other films, for the film currently being viewed.

boxSets.thisFilmAudio.description: Roku screen reader announcement for the card of the film currently viewed within its box set. {title}: the film's title.

boxSets.unavailable.description: Roku box set screen: error heading when the box set cannot be shown.

boxSets.unavailableBody.description: Roku box set screen: explanation under the unavailable heading, giving possible reasons the box set cannot be shown.

boxSets.error.description: Roku box set screen: error message when loading the box set fails, with a retry button; says to check the TV's network connection.

rows.exploreAll.description: Roku home and library rows: label on the final card of a row that opens the row's full page.

rows.moreAudio.description: Roku screen reader announcement for the last card of a row that opens the full page. {label}: the card's label, such as Explore all; {title}: the row's title.

rowPage.item.description: Roku full row page: item count shown in the header. Counts the items in the row. {count}: the number of items.

rowPage.empty.description: Roku full row page: empty-state heading when the row has no items.

rowPage.emptyBody.description: Roku full row page: supporting line under the empty heading.

rowPage.unavailable.description: Roku full row page: heading shown when the row can no longer be loaded.

rowPage.unavailableBody.description: Roku full row page: supporting line under the unavailable heading.

filters.eyebrowList.description: Roku filter panel: small uppercase line above the title when the list of filter categories is shown.

filters.eyebrowValues.description: Roku filter panel: small uppercase line above the title when the values of one filter category are shown.

filters.title.description: Roku filter panel: title at the top of the panel.

filters.facet.itemType.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by kind of item (movies or series).

filters.facet.genre.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by genre.

filters.facet.decade.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by decade of release.

filters.facet.watchStatus.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by watched state.

filters.facet.contentRating.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by age or content rating, such as PG-13.

filters.facet.resolution.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by video resolution, such as 4K.

filters.facet.dynamicRange.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by video dynamic range (HDR or Dolby Vision).

filters.facet.studio.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by production studio.

filters.facet.network.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by the TV network that aired a show.

filters.facet.country.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by country of origin.

filters.facet.audioLanguage.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by the language of the audio track.

filters.facet.subtitleLanguage.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by subtitle language.

filters.facet.originalLanguage.description: Roku filter panel: category row for filtering by the title's original language.

filters.value.movie.description: Roku filter panel: option under the Type category to show only movies.

filters.value.series.description: Roku filter panel: option under the Type category to show only TV series.

filters.value.hdr.description: Roku filter panel: option under the Dynamic Range category for HDR video (high dynamic range).

filters.value.dolby_vision.description: Roku filter panel: option under the Dynamic Range category for Dolby Vision video. Dolby Vision is a brand name.

filters.value.unwatched.description: Roku filter panel: option under Watch Status to show titles not yet watched.

filters.value.inProgress.description: Roku filter panel: option under Watch Status to show titles partly watched.

filters.value.watched.description: Roku filter panel: option under Watch Status to show titles already watched.

filters.value.favorited.description: Roku filter panel: option under Watch Status to show titles the user marked as favorites.

filters.value.watchlist.description: Roku filter panel: option under Watch Status to show titles on the user's watchlist.

filters.decade.description: Roku filter panel: option under the Decade category. {year}: the first year of the decade, such as 1990, so the text reads like 1990s.

filters.any.description: Roku filter panel: value shown on a category row when no option in it is selected.

filters.selected.description: Roku filter panel: value shown on a category row summarizing how many options are chosen. {count}: the number of selected options.

filters.none.description: Roku filter panel: message shown when no filter categories are available for the library.

filters.allFilters.description: Roku filter panel: row at the top of a category's values that goes back to the list of all filter categories.

filters.clearFacet.description: Roku filter panel: row that clears the selections in one category. {facet}: the category name, such as Genre.

filters.match.description: Roku filter panel: section header above the choice of how multiple selected filters combine.

filters.matchAll.description: Roku filter panel: radio option meaning a title must match every selected filter.

filters.matchAny.description: Roku filter panel: radio option meaning a title may match any one of the selected filters.

filters.options.description: Roku filter panel: section header above extra settings, such as remembering sort and filters.

filters.preserve.description: Roku filter panel: checkbox row that keeps the sort and filters when the user returns to the library later.

filters.reset.description: Roku filter panel: row that clears all filters and returns to defaults.

filters.done.description: Roku filter panel: row at the bottom that applies the choices and closes the panel.

filters.selectedSpoken.description: Roku screen reader word added after a filter option's name when that option is selected.

shuffle.failedTitle.description: Roku shuffle error notice: short title used as the first part of the notice when shuffle playback cannot start.

shuffle.failedNotice.description: Roku shuffle error toast combining a title and a reason. {title}: the short error title, such as Couldn't Shuffle; {message}: the reason it failed.

shuffle.nothingToPlay.description: Roku shuffle error reason when the library or collection has no playable items.

shuffle.notFound.description: Roku shuffle error reason when the library or collection no longer exists on the server.

shuffle.failed.description: Roku shuffle generic error reason for any other failure to start shuffle playback.

browse.error.load.description: Roku error message on browse screens (home, library, calendar, requests and others) when content fails to load; shown with a retry button. Says to check the TV's connection.

buffering.promptTitle.description: Roku player: title of the pill prompt that appears when playback keeps stalling to buffer.

buffering.promptMessage.description: Roku player: message in the buffering prompt suggesting a lower video quality so playback can continue.

buffering.lower.description: Roku player: primary button in the buffering prompt that lowers the video quality.

buffering.keep.description: Roku player: secondary button in the buffering prompt that leaves the video quality unchanged.

buffering.undoCaption.description: Roku player: caption of the pill shown after quality was lowered automatically, next to a button to undo it.

buffering.restore.description: Roku player: button in the pill shown after quality was lowered, which restores the previous quality.

buffering.lowered.description: Roku player: brief on-screen notice that quality was lowered to stop buffering.

buffering.cantLower.description: Roku player: brief on-screen notice when the quality cannot be lowered for the current video.

options.tabInfo.description: Roku player options panel: tab name for the tab showing information about the video.

options.tabStats.description: Roku player options panel: tab name for the tab showing technical playback statistics.

options.tabVideo.description: Roku player options panel: tab name for the video settings tab, such as quality.

options.tabAudio.description: Roku player options panel: tab name for the tab where the audio track is chosen.

options.tabSubtitles.description: Roku player options panel: tab name for the tab where the subtitle track is chosen.

options.quality.description: Roku player options panel: row label for the streaming quality setting on the Video tab.

options.auto.description: Roku player options panel: quality option where quality is chosen automatically.

options.autoLimited.description: Roku player options panel: quality row value showing automatic quality is currently capped because of earlier buffering.

options.quality4k.description: Roku player options panel: quality option name for 4K resolution.

options.qualityUpTo.description: Roku player options panel: quality option capping the stream resolution. {resolution}: the highest resolution, such as 1080p.

options.qualityUpToHd.description: Roku player options panel: quality option capping the stream resolution, marked HD. {resolution}: the highest resolution, such as 720p.

options.autoplayNext.description: Roku player options panel: row label for the setting that automatically plays the next episode.

options.on.description: Roku player options panel: value shown when a setting such as auto-play next is switched on.

options.off.description: Roku player options panel: value shown when a setting is switched off.

options.captions.description: Roku player options panel: row label for the closed captions setting.

options.captionOn.description: Roku player options panel: captions option meaning captions are always shown.

options.captionReplay.description: Roku player options panel: captions option meaning captions show only during an instant replay.

options.captionMute.description: Roku player options panel: captions option meaning captions show only while the sound is muted.

options.track.description: Roku player options panel: fallback name for an audio or subtitle track that has no language or title. {number}: the track's position, such as 2.

options.default.description: Roku player options panel: small tag on an audio or subtitle track flagged as the default track.

options.forced.description: Roku player options panel: small tag on a subtitle track flagged as forced (shows only foreign-language dialogue).

options.sdh.description: Roku player options panel: tag on a subtitle track made for the deaf and hard of hearing (SDH).

options.selected.description: Roku player options panel: screen reader word added after the track or option that is currently selected.

options.notShowing.description: Roku player options panel: status shown when no subtitle track is displayed.

options.loading.description: Roku player options panel: placeholder shown while track or subtitle lists are loading.

options.unsupported.description: Roku player options panel: note on a track whose format the Roku cannot play.

options.tabChapters.description: Roku player options panel: tab name for the tab listing the video's chapters.

options.chapters.description: Roku player options panel: heading of the chapter list.

options.chapter.description: Roku player options panel: fallback label for a chapter without a title.

options.chapterNumbered.description: Roku player options panel: fallback name for a chapter without a title. {number}: the chapter's position, such as 3.

options.playing.description: Roku player options panel: screen reader word added after the chapter that is currently playing.

options.searchSubtitles.description: Roku player options panel: row on the Subtitles tab that opens online subtitle search.
